name: romaine lettuce

retail_price.source: USDA ERS Price Spreads from Farm to Consumer (retail data: Circana)

layer_sources.farmworker: Estimate: farm labor is about one-third of farm revenue for fresh fruits and vegetables (Philip Martin, UC Davis, as cited by the Economic Policy Institute). Applied to the ERS farm value. USDA ERS Price Spreads from Farm to Consumer, 2025 (https://www.ers.usda.gov/media/5756/fresh-lettuce-romaine.csv)
layer_sources.farm_owner_and_costs: ERS farm value minus the farmworker estimate. USDA ERS Price Spreads from Farm to Consumer, 2025 (https://www.ers.usda.gov/media/5756/fresh-lettuce-romaine.csv)
layer_sources.after_the_farm: ERS retail price minus ERS farm value. USDA ERS Price Spreads from Farm to Consumer, 2025 (https://www.ers.usda.gov/media/5756/fresh-lettuce-romaine.csv)

trend_2yr.source: USDA ERS Price Spreads from Farm to Consumer (nominal dollars)

notes: AMS quotes romaine per carton and no published carton weight exists; at the 50 lb iceberg weight the shipping-point price (39.5 c/lb, 2025) is far below ERS's farm price (59.7 c/lb), so the weight is wrong for romaine. Wholesale and store layers are not split.
Estimate: farm labor is about one-third of farm revenue for fresh fruits and vegetables (Philip Martin, UC Davis, as cited by the Economic Policy Institute).
